content: व्यभिचर् €1 <ab>P.</ab> ²1 To go astray, deviate from; as in अव्यभिचरितं साध्यसामान्याधिकरण्यं व्याप्तिः <ls>Tarka K.</ls> .²2 To transgress against, be faithless to; तस्मात् खधर्मं भूतानां राजा न व्यभिचारयेत् <ls>Kau. A. 1. 3</ls>. .²3 To act crookedly. .²4 To offend, injure. .²5 To fail, miscarry. .²6 To practise sorcery.
